title: Mine Field
summary: A mine-clearing puzzle, with fair boards that never need a guess.
description: Dig the safe cells and flag the mines, by touch or keyboard. The board always fits the screen: the three levels are sized from your display. The first dig is always safe, the Fair boards setting lays only boards that logic can finish, and Hint points at a sure cell. Best times, statistics and the game in progress are kept on the board. No network. Needs a screen of at least 640x480 (portrait 480x640 in PDA mode).
